text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober has been preoccupied with something ever since the Fan Fest. She manages to pull herself together right before her race, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the paddock, she runs into Mejiro Bright and is nearly crushed by her friend's oppressive aura and focus. It's clear how determined Mejiro Bright is to win the spring Tenno Sho.
